controls.name: (C1) KNOWN dependent data (shared latent e1, e2 for receiver and sources; clock e3): CORR (latent subdivision) contains all 42 truths and is not wider than BOX for r, l, l'; matched widths and cost
(C2) independent rectangle: the evaluator with SEPARATE parameters for receiver q and w covers every admissible corner (input level) and contains every truth (output level)
(N1) negative, lost-correlation in its dangerous form: TYING w's parameter to q's (eta := xi) leaves admissible rectangle corners uncovered (input level); output-level miss reported
(N2) negative: CORR intersected with a shifted box NOT proved to contain the truth is empty or misses the truth; CORR intersected with BOX (both proved) keeps every truth
(N3) negative: the source-history sensitivity entered with the swapped sign misses some truth (or the contraction empties)

(N4) negative/known: independent source-history remainder +-0.03: omitted -> the history enclosure misses the true history (input level); kept -> it contains it and the output enclosure contains every truth
(K-A) EXACT affine flow with constant w: every latent cell encloses the exact q(t) - Q(s) = 0.33; cell width at most 2 x 0.02 / n; the independent box has width 0.04

(K-B) EXACT correlated polynomial image: F = (e1 + e2)(e1 - e2) has exact range [-1, 1] with known vertices; the latent subdivision contains it with excess at most 4/n + 4/n^2; the independent box gives [-4, 4]
